Meta.title: Resumate Partner | A modern, minimal resume builder that exports Word
Meta.description: Fill in a form, preview live, and download an editable Word (.docx) resume. No sign-up, your data stays in your browser, and the clean layout is ATS-friendly.

hero.title: A clean resume in 3 minutes. <hl>Download Word, edit anytime.</hl>
hero.subtitle: Fill in the form, watch the live preview, and download a .docx. Unlike a PDF, you can fine-tune every word in Word.

word.title: An editable Word file
word.desc: A native .docx with real paragraphs, bullet lists and heading styles, so you can tweak it before applying.

private.title: No account, data stays local
private.desc: Everything is stored in your browser and the Word file is generated there too. Nothing is sent to a server.

ats.title: Clean and ATS-friendly
ats.desc: Single column, no tables or icons. Applicant tracking systems read it correctly and recruiters scan it fast.

fill.title: Fill in
fill.desc: Add your details, experience, skills and summary.

preview.title: Preview live
preview.desc: An A4 page on the right shows the final look instantly.

download.title: Download Word
download.desc: Get a .docx in one click and polish it in Word.

why.a: PDFs are hard to edit once downloaded. A Word file lets you tailor your resume for each role, and many employers accept or require .docx.

data.a: Only in this browser (localStorage). There is no server database and we never collect resume content. Use “Export JSON” to back up or move to another computer.

jobsite.q: Can I use it on job boards?
jobsite.a: Yes. Upload the .docx as an attachment, or copy and paste its content into application forms.

pages.q: Are page breaks the same as in the preview?
pages.a: Close, but Word decides the final page breaks. The dashed lines in the preview only mark A4 page positions.

wordMarks.q: Why is there a small square next to headings like Education in Word?
wordMarks.a: That’s Word’s “keep with next” marker. It only shows while formatting marks (¶) are visible, never prints, and won’t appear in a saved PDF. It just keeps each heading attached to the content below it.

toolbar.clearConfirm: Clear all resume data? This cannot be undone. Consider exporting a JSON backup first.
toolbar.iosHint: On iPhone/iPad the file opens in a preview first — tap Share → Save to Files.
toolbar.loadSampleConfirm: Load sample data? Your current data will be overwritten.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.p1: Resumate Partner requires no sign-up and has no accounts or server-side database.
Privacy.p2: Everything you enter is stored only in this browser’s localStorage. The Word file is generated in your browser as well and is never uploaded to our servers.
Privacy.p3: Clearing your browser data or clicking “Clear data” deletes this content. We recommend backing up with “Export JSON”.
Privacy.p4: We use Vercel Analytics to count anonymous page views. It uses no cookies and never records resume content.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.p1: Resumate Partner is a free resume tool provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind.
Terms.p2: Your resume content belongs to you. Everything you enter stays in your browser, and we claim no rights to it.
Terms.p3: You may use the generated files for any purpose, including job applications and other commercial uses.
Terms.p4: We may change or discontinue the service at any time. Continued use means you accept the current terms.

About.title: About
About.p1: Resumate Partner is a small, independent tool for building clean, ATS-friendly resumes and downloading them as editable Word files.
About.p2: We built it because most resume builders either lock your file behind a sign-up or only export a PDF you can’t edit. Here there are no accounts, no uploads, and no paywall.
About.p3: Everything runs in your browser, and the layout is designed to be readable by both recruiters and applicant tracking systems.
